what: Swiss title card: a grid draws, a rule and a typed eyebrow, the title rises line by line from masks, a marker hops while it holds
title: Slow is smooth, smooth is fast
intent: Open a chapter or a video with a calm, confident title
action: The grid is drawing on frame 0; the rule draws across, the eyebrow types, the title's lines rise from their masks in a cascade and the subtitle settles; an accent marker hops along the rule and the cursor blinks while it holds; it all reverses faster to exit
look: Swiss / International: paper, black ink, one orange accent, a visible six-column grid, flush left (style atlas #1)
make_it_yours: Set `EYEBROW` and `SUBTITLE` (or `''`), the palette and `COLUMNS`. There is no light layer and the tone map is `clip`, so ink and accent keep their colours.
craft_note: Every curve is a Timeline track with After Effects influence. Low `outInfluence` leaves sharp, high `inInfluence` lands soft: tune them like the Graph Editor. Swiss means flush left and a grid you can see.
